props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment; omitted values follow the control layout.

props.name: autofocus
props.description: Whether to automatically focus the input on mount.

props.name: autofocusDelay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds before focusing the input.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: decrement
props.description: Whether to show the decrement button.

props.name: decrementDisabled
props.description: Whether the decrement button is disabled.

props.name: decrementIcon
props.description: Icon for the decrement button.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Default displayed value for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: form
props.description: The ID of an external form that owns the native spinbutton.

props.name: holdRepeat
props.description: Whether press-and-hold should trigger repeated value changes.

props.name: id
props.description: The ID of the input element.

props.name: increment
props.description: Whether to show the increment button.

props.name: incrementDisabled
props.description: Whether the increment button is disabled.

props.name: incrementIcon
props.description: Icon for the increment button.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Optional inner input element ref.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The step size used for PageUp/PageDown.

props.name: locale
props.description:
Locale for number formatting and parsing.
Uses browser default if not specified.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Maximum allowed numeric value.

props.name: minValue
props.description: Minimum allowed numeric value.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Callback when the input loses focus.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback when the formatted string value changes.

props.name: onDecrementClick
props.description: Callback when the decrement button is clicked.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Callback when the input gains focus.

props.name: onIncrementClick
props.description: Callback when the increment button is clicked.

props.name: onRawValueChange
props.description: Callback when the numeric value changes.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Visual layout direction.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text for the input.

props.name: rawValue
props.description: Controlled numeric value. Takes precedence over `value`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the input is read-only.

props.name: repeatDelayMs
props.description: Delay in milliseconds before repeated value changes start.

props.name: repeatIntervalMs
props.description: Interval in milliseconds between repeated value changes.

props.name: repeatPointerTypes
props.description: Pointer types that can trigger press-and-hold repeat.

props.name: repeatThrottleMs
props.description: Minimum elapsed time in milliseconds between repeat triggers.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the input is required.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: step
props.description: The increment/decrement step size.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled displayed value.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.

props.name: wheel
props.description: Whether mouse wheel changes the value while the input is focused.
